title: FBI-UAP-D024, FD-302, “Airborne Lights and Triangle,” 2002, 2023-2024
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview record of a former military pilot describing multiple UAP sightings in 2023-2024 and a historical sighting in 2002.

incidents.summary: Pilot observed multiple white lights in the sky while flying from Boston to Dublin.
incidents.duration: 10 seconds to one minute per cycle
incidents.quote: The lights were white in color, would start out as dim, and get brighter before they eventually faded out.

incidents.summary: Pilot captured video of white lights while flying northwest of Minneapolis.
incidents.quote: white lights were seen, sometimes ten or more present at once, moving around in straight lines

incidents.summary: Pilot observed a large, silent, equilateral triangle-shaped object blocking out stars over Bagram.
incidents.quote: It appeared as if something huge went overhead, from west to east, and was an equilateral triangle shape.
